baseline.deterministic_basis: The unchanged route, robustness, safety, and coordination input contracts are the comparison basis; no runtime A/B measurement was run.

candidate.deterministic_basis: A pure evaluator computes each file-backed state/action transition, including the primary ledger gate, role-action ownership, Sol-ledger tester repair authorization, fixed explorer-only evidence-role admission, child-covered handoff scope, typed/non-empty evidence contexts, resolved handoff provenance, and relevant/rescope-only terminal filtering; expected values are fixture oracles, not the evaluator decision source.

computed_state_transition_evidence.evaluator_scope: instruction-contract evidence, not runtime scheduler enforcement; computed handoff provenance, child-to-handoff scope coverage, fixed evidence-role admission, typed/non-empty evidence contexts, and Sol-ledger repair authorization

zero_same_scope_active_child_overlap.evidence: Computed evaluator rejects unlisted primary work and primary/cross-role same-scope overlap while allowing only declared orthogonal scope and role-safe continuation.

zero_preterminal_dependent_phase_or_acce.evidence: Computed evaluator waits for all acceptance-relevant predecessors and requires disposition plus handoff/artifact inspection.

existing_route_robustness_safety_suites_.evidence: The 0.6.8 route, robustness, and safety fixtures remain in place and verify.sh retains their checks.

runtime_latency_target.note: Actual isolated A/B latency, token counts, and service-tier response metadata are missing evidence; the target is not claimed achieved.
